summary: Generated one P1 DW-75-API-001 supporting wire-record contract test. INSERT, receiver GET and exact-ID admin DELETE all use apiRequest and runtime Zod schema validation; sender authToken and new partnerAuthToken fixture avoid inline sign-in. Test uses a factory UUID and always performs checked exact-ID admin cleanup while preserving assertion failures. No production response schema was found for interactions; a test-local Zod schema validates the successful INSERT shape and server timestamp. Callback ownership is covered elsewhere. Existing check-constraint-error-mapping.spec.ts already covers the interaction error contract, so no unrelated error/RLS expansion was generated. Pact MCP was already probed unreachable; source/schema fallback used, no re-probe or Pact artifacts. Confidence 9/10. Mandate self-check found no raw request methods, direct spec imports from Playwright, sleeps, console logging or inline authentication. Tests were not executed.
